conventions: Every edit to packages/catalog-model/src is comment-only: add lines inside new or existing /** ... */ blocks; never change, move or delete a code line, an import, an existing comment line, or a release tag.
Never add a blank line outside a comment block (no blank line between interface members or class members), so every added line of the src diff is /**, a ' * ...' line, or ' */'.

TSDoc blocks are always multi-line: '/**' on its own line, one ' * ' prefix per line, ' */' on its own line, indented to the member they document (2 spaces inside an interface or class, 0 at top level).
Wrap comment prose at about 80 columns; prettier (singleQuote, trailingComma all, arrowParens avoid; config at packages/cli/config/prettier.json) does not rewrap comments.

Summaries are one or two short sentence-case sentences ending with a period, in present tense and active voice, describing what the code does, never what the name suggests (doc style guide at docs/contribute/doc-style-guide.md).

Tag order inside a block: summary, blank ' *' line, optional '@remarks' section (tag line, blank ' *' line, prose), blank ' *' line, '@param <name> - <Description>' lines, '@returns <description>', '@throws <description>' when it throws, then any existing release tag last.
Parameter lines use the package form '@param value - The value to check' (name, space, hyphen, space, capitalised description, no trailing period).

Wrap literal values, field paths and code fragments in backticks (for example `backstage.io/v1alpha1`, `metadata.namespace`, `true`); use {@link Symbol} only for symbols exported from the package entry point (src/index.ts), such as {@link ApiEntityV1alpha1} or {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain}.
Do not name internal, non-exported helpers or private fields in a comment (for example the local require/optional functions in FieldFormatEntityPolicy, or private fields such as parentRef).
Do not touch copyright headers; new non-source files (the changeset) carry none.
report.api.md and report-alpha.api.md are never typed: the api-reports project check regenerates them after the last unit.

decisions.topic: How the API reports are regenerated
decisions.choice: The first project check runs `yarn build:api-reports packages/catalog-model`, which regenerates report.api.md and report-alpha.api.md for this package only; the second asserts no `(undocumented)` marker remains in report.api.md.
decisions.reason: The unscoped run may rewrite other packages' reports, which are off-limits; a docs run holds no tooling unit; Gate 0 allows the reports to change only through the tool.

decisions.topic: Release tag position in the type guard blocks
decisions.choice: New lines go between the existing '/**' line and the existing ' * @public' line, so @param and @returns come before @public and @public stays last and unchanged.
decisions.reason: FR-4 requires the existing @public tag to stay unchanged and last, and inserting after '/**' keeps the diff additions-only.

decisions.choice: Link to the V1alpha1 interface name ({@link ApiEntityV1alpha1}, {@link ComponentEntityV1alpha1}, and so on), never the ApiEntity-style alias.
decisions.reason: The report prints guard return types as the V1alpha1 interfaces, and those names are exported from both entry points.

decisions.topic: Required versus optional wording in spec comments
decisions.choice: Required/optional wording follows the TypeScript type (a field without ? is required, a field with ? is optional); where the kind JSON schema disagrees with the type (User `memberOf` is optional in the type but required by the schema) the comment names the field without calling it required or optional.
rejected: follow the type and ignore the schema
decisions.reason: FR-3 forbids contradicting the type, and NFR-3 forbids a statement the schema makes false.

decisions.topic: Shape of the enforce method comments
decisions.choice: Each enforce block has a summary, an optional @remarks section for detail, '@param entity - ...', '@returns ...', and '@throws ...' only when the method body or an operation it performs throws.
decisions.reason: FR-6 asks for policy-specific return and throw behaviour, which the inherited generic text in entity/policies/types.ts does not give.
